answers.scancard: {"fact":"La Rioja Alta was founded in 1890 by five families from Rioja and the Basque Country who pooled resources to make wine together.","fit":"Your 94 on the 2016 and strong Tempranillo and Rioja averages make this Tempranillo-led blend a near-certain hit.","caution":"Decant for at least an hour — Ardanza rewards patience and opens up considerably once it has had time to breathe.","origin":"Rioja sits inland in northern Spain, sheltered by the Cantabrian Mountains, where the Ebro River tempers a harsh, continental climate.","region_style":"Rioja blends Tempranillo's structure with oak aging traditions to produce wines that are elegant, earthy, and built to last.","estate":"La Rioja Alta has been family-owned since 1890 and is one of Rioja's most respected classic houses, known for long, careful aging.","talk":["La Rioja Alta is one of Rioja's great old houses","Ardanza is a Tempranillo-led blend with serious aging behind it","The 2016 scored a 94 — this vintage follows the same recipe"],"fact2":"As a Rioja Reserva, this wine must age a minimum of 3 years before release, including at least 1 year in oak barrel and at least 6 months in bottle."}
